title: A custom palatal jig for segmented complete arch interim prosthesis shell: A step-by-step technique
html: Complete arch maxillary teeth preparation for fixed prosthodontic rehabilitation requires interim restorations that maintain the planned occlusal plane, vertical dimension of occlusion, and esthetics while accommodating multiple paths of insertion. Conventional splinted shell techniques require seating along a single path of insertion and may result in incomplete seating, distortion, marginal discrepancies, or locking when preparations are divergent. A segmented interim prosthesis shell technique guided by a custom palatal jig is described.
